raw_segments.text: Wombed in sin darkness I was too, made not begotten.
By them, the man with my voice and my eyes and a ghost woman with ashes on her breath.
They clasped and sundered, did the couplers will.
From before the ages he willed me and now may not will me away or ever.
Is that then the divine substance wherein father and son are consubstantial?
